sentences.text: This is an application under Section 482 of the BNSS, 2023 praying for grant of anticipatory bail in respect of Barama P.S. Case No.56/2024, registered under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The case against the petitioner in a nutshell is that- a 20 year old girl was in love with the present petitioner.
During their relationship, they had physical relationship also.
The petitioner allegedly took some nude photographs of the girl.
4. With the passage of time, their relationship broke down.
He knew the passwords of the instagram account of the girl and thereafter he uploaded her nude photographs in the instagram account.
5. The petitioner is also a 20 year old boy.
He already appeared before the Investigating Police Officer and his statement got also recorded.
6. Mr. Borthakur has objected to the bail prayer.
7. After considering the submissions made by the learned counsel of both sides, this Court is of the opinion that for the aforesaid offence, the petitioner does not deserve to be detained in custody.
Therefore, his pre- arrest bail application is allowed.
8. The interim bail order granted by this Court in favour of the petitioner Shri Manashjyoti Talukdar on 30.07.2024 is made absolute.
The application for bail is disposed of accordingly.
Case diary shall be returned.
